t: This is Hertford House, home of the Wallace Collection. The 2nd Marquess of Hertford founded the house, and his son the 3rd Marquess, a Tory politician and art collector, died here. The collection was built up by several generations of the family, including Sir Richard Wallace. His widow, Lady Wallace, lived here from 1872 and died here in 1897. She left about five and a half thousand artworks to the nation, and the house opened as a public museum thirteen years after her death.
